from decimal import Decimal
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
from app.money import money_total
cases = [([], '0.00'), (['1.005'], '1.01'), (['-1.005'], '-1.01'), (['0.1', '0.2'], '0.30'), (['0.005', '0.005'], '0.01'), (['1'], '1.00'), (iter(['2.335']), '2.34')]
for values, expected in cases:
    actual = money_total(values)
    assert isinstance(actual, Decimal)
    assert actual == Decimal(expected), (actual, expected)
    assert actual.as_tuple().exponent == -2, actual
assert hashlib.sha256(Path('acceptance.py').read_bytes()).hexdigest() == '999695e34fdc23b7a39dd5da4350d50fac42ffbb73207fc4dcdda1097983886d'
print('7 focused cases passed; acceptance.py SHA-256 unchanged')
